items.title: Randy Brecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 12, 2022
items.q: Lew and I would take trumpet lessons and had been doing that for a while with Edward Truetel in New Jersey.

ctx.x: You know you’re pushing a button with me because I was in a group that was fairly successfully locally and doing gigs, and the producer wanted us to get a lead singer who just stood there and sang — you know like a lead singer. And we just resisted the heck out of it. And the difference in the story was our salary never went up five thousand percent.

Yeah it was a funny time. And Lew and I would take trumpet lessons and had been doing that for a while with Edward Truetel in New Jersey. We’d take a bus to his house. Then Lewey started picking me up in a limo you know, cackling all the time. And like I said I was making two fifty a week and Horace had left out of the deal that he took taxes out. I’ll never forget these figures, so it was really $147.50 a week and I had to pay my hotel out of that.
How much older — can you recall how much older was Horace Silver than you at the time?
